rationale: Read all 29 sessions in chronological order (629 turns). I find exactly two distinct actual script rejection events: the major-company rejection letter at D14:1 (clarified at D14:5), and the 'another rejection' from a production company at D24:12 (confirmed at D24:14 as the film-contest submission discussed at D16:1). Repeated references and clarifications are grouped with their respective events. D27:12-D27:13 describes only anticipated rejections from recently submitted scripts and is not counted. No additional actual rejection or unresolved ambiguity changes the count; the reference count of 2 and upstream answer 'Twice' are supported.
